commons.title: Cayuse Tribe - DPLA - 2a2bd5416ad7db9886317526d8e305ad.jpg
commons.credit: File URL IIIF manifest Catalog record
commons.description: A Native American women, identified as Eat-no-meat and a member of the Cayuse Tribe, is standing outside in front of a blanket. She is wearing a Euro-American style dress, a necklace, a leather belt, earrings, and a blanket wrapped around her shoulders. Her hair has been tied into braids. She is carrying a bag in her left hand. The name is probably a translation of her Indian name; tribal members are attempting to verify her name.
commons.source_category: Photographs of the Cayuse people by Lee Moorhouse
commons.editorial_reason: Caption identifies a Cayuse woman; visible braids, necklace, earrings, blanket, and traditional accessories provide cultural content.

commons.title: Chief Bones and wife Palouse Tribe - DPLA - f9c4e275ec4b5da881aa0a657976de34.jpg
commons.credit: File URL IIIF manifest Catalog record
commons.description: A Native American man and woman sitting in front of a blanket hanging from a latticework fence. Both wear necklaces. The woman's hair is braided, she is wearing a headband, has a blanket draped around her and holds a bag with geometric designs in her right hand. The man has furs hanging from his shoulders and hair. He is wearing armbands decorated with teeth or claws and is holding a shawl. There is a blanket in his lap. He has been identified by tribal members as Peter Gibbon of the Cayuse tribe.
commons.source_category: Photographs of the Cayuse people by Lee Moorhouse
commons.editorial_reason: Although the description identifies one person as Cayuse, the title identifies the subjects as Palouse Tribe, creating an unresolved attribution conflict.

commons.title: Chief Red Hawk Cayuse Tribe - DPLA - a49f840fb1b89ba393fb98b11adfcab3.jpg
commons.credit: File URL IIIF manifest Catalog record
commons.description: A Native American man, identified as Chief Red Hawk of the Cayuse Tribe, is seated in front of a solid colored blanket that is suspended like a backdrop. The man is wearing a cloth shirt and has a Pendleton blanket wrapped around his body from the chest down. He has long hair, some of which is tied in a scarf that drapes over his shoulder. He is wearing a beaded choker and beaded bracelets. In his lap, one hand is holding a bow and two arrows and a pipe with a long, flat, wooden handle. His other hand is holding up a war club, which is adorned with feathers. A cowboy hat with a braided or twisted scarf hat band is hung on the backdrop. The image appears to be an outside photograph, as there is some vegetation visible in the bottom corners.
commons.editorial_reason: Caption identifies Chief Red Hawk as Cayuse; the image shows beadwork, a Pendleton blanket, bow, arrows, pipe, and war club.

commons.title: Chief Ume-Somkin—Cayuse Tribe - DPLA - 8a9c2676c09fd169da119fb6fcc58f51.jpg
commons.credit: File URL IIIF manifest Catalog record
commons.description: An outside photograph of a Native American man who has been identified as Uma-Som-Kin. He is standing with a horse and dog to his left, and a tipi behind him. His hair is in braids with hair ornaments or ties attached to their ends and he is wearing a cowboy hat. He is dressed in a shirt, and over that a coat made out of a Pendleton Blanket. In his right hand he is holding a rifle, and in his left hand both a hand drum and horse reins. He is wearing either calf-high boots or moccasins. The horse or pony has a spotted coat; it is bareback with what appears to be a leather halter. The dog is between the horse and man. It also has a mottled or spotted coat, with uncropped ears and unknown breed heritage. The tipi is made of canvas layers. There is a cloth or canvas doorway directly behind the man; on the back of the tipi leans a broken tule mat. commons.editorial_reason: Caption identifies a Cayuse man; the image visibly shows a tipi, blanket clothing, braids, drum, rifle, horse, and dog.

commons.title: Dr. Whirlwind, Cayuse Indian, on horse - DPLA - 75f77e99709c363c47e9b4b4df5fd6bd.jpg
commons.credit: File URL IIIF manifest Catalog record
commons.description: A Native American man, identified as Dr. Whirl-wind (Charley Whirlwind, Sr.) of the Cayuse Tribe, is mounted on a horse. The man is wearing buckskin pants and shirt and moccasins. The shirt is decorated with feathers and beadwork on the front and sleeves. He is wearing a headdress with a full crown of feathers and strips of fur hanging down around his shoulders. He has a large beaded choker. The horse is solid brown in color and has a saddle, saddle blanket and bridle. On the ground in front of the horse is a dog with long, fluffy white hair. The man, horse, and dog are on a slope on the side of a mountain. Around them are some other slopes and some stands of pine trees. The top of the mountain is in the background.
commons.editorial_reason: Caption identifies Dr. Whirlwind as Cayuse; the image shows buckskin clothing, beadwork, feathered headdress, and moccasins.
